clips.title: The story
paras: A formal summons calls promising Forsaken warlocks to advanced training in Undercity. Carendin Halgar expects those who have reached a threshold in their craft to join him in the Magic Quarter, where dangerous Nether beings await.

Word of a warlock's control over basic fel energies travels from Brill or the Tirisfal wilderness to Undercity. Ageron Kargal, a senior practitioner who spots talent, sends notice to those who show promise. Carendin Halgar's summons marks a rare privilege and a perilous step in a warlock's training. Basic imps and petty curses no longer suffice.

Carendin Halgar oversees warlock rites in Undercity's Magic Quarter, near the Temple of the Damned. Forsaken darkcasters lack the living's moral restraint, but planar summonings still demand discipline. Halgar tolerates neither hesitation nor sentimentality. Those called to him are expected to show deference and be ready to face the hostile horrors of the Twisting Nether.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, friend! I just received word from Carendin Halgar that he would like to see you for further training.
You should be proud of yourself, friend. It's not every day that Master Halgar personally sees fit to instruct a young warlock.
You'll be able to find him in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, near the Temple of the Damned.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good, I see Ageron managed to find you, friend. Let us waste little time with small talk and pleasantries and focus on your training. There is still much you have to learn.
